notes: Fable with_skill: PERFECT 12/12 across all 3 evals (iter1: 9/12). All three iter1 failures fixed: quiz now present in eval-1, eval-2 stayed brief (~14 lines core), Japanese consistent, diagram-first.

Haiku with_skill: 5/12 vs iter1 7/12 — slightly worse; Haiku still drops pipeline context and toy data (eval-1), and applied full quiz ritual to the trivial chore commit (eval-2). Depth-calibration wording did not land for Haiku.

Interpretation: the skill is now excellent for the session model (Fable). Haiku compliance would need starker, rule-like phrasing (e.g. explicit decision checklist before writing), at the cost of prose the user liked. Recommend accepting current state unless Haiku is a target runtime.
